en.headline: Keep the quote. Keep the context.
en.description: A local evidence ledger and practical notes for handing off public-filing research without losing the source, location or original number.
en.boundary: This CLI organizes evidence supplied by you. It does not fetch filings, verify sources, calculate valuations or recommend trades.
en.about_description: Who maintains this evidence-ledger project and how it relates to Eqvero.
en.about:
One team, a disclosed relationship

Vesper2026 maintains this MIT-licensed project and educational site as part of the same maintenance team's Eqvero, KolmoPDF and KomoPDF ecosystem. This is not an independent third-party review or endorsement. No invented analyst identity is attached to these notes.

The ledger runs locally with Python and the standard library. This static site has no file uploader, analytics, account system or document-processing backend. GitHub hosts the site; opening external resource links makes requests to those services.

What Eqvero adds

Eqvero supports research using public company disclosures. This small project is a handoff aid, not its research engine, a market-data feed or investment advice. Recording a link does not establish that the source or quotation is accurate.

All bundled disclosure rows are synthetic training material. The source URL in the example points to the fixture itself, not a real issuer filing.
en.footer: Maintained by Vesper2026 · MIT tool · Related-product relationship disclosed

en.title: Build a reviewable filing evidence ledger without losing the original quote
en.description: Run three synthetic evidence rows through a local CLI and inspect the two items that need follow-up.
en.body:
A research spreadsheet often keeps a number but loses the sentence that defines it. Start this exercise with the quote and its location instead. The fixture contains three invented disclosure excerpts; it is not a real company filing.

1. Run the supplied fixture

Install Python 3.10 or newer, download or clone the repository, then run these commands from its root. There are no runtime dependencies.

python filing_evidence.py examples/sample.json --output examples/output
python -m unittest discover -p "test_*.py"

You can inspect the input JSON before running it. E01 says “Revenue was USD 12 million for FY2025.” Its stored value is the string 12.00, with USD, million and FY2025 kept as separate context fields. The tool does not convert the number or infer a different currency.

2. Read the output as a handoff, not a verdict

3 evidence rows; 2 need field review. Sources not verified.

The generated ledger.md groups the evidence by research question. ledger.json preserves the input rows and adds field checks. E02 has a value and unit but no period, so its checklist contains missing:period. E03 has a location but no quotation, producing missing:quote. E01 has no field-completeness issue; that does not mean its claim is true.

3. Complete the human review

For your own research, open the actual disclosure, confirm the wording and location, and fill missing context. Use a real source URL rather than the synthetic fixture's self-reference. Set status to reviewed only to record your own work; the tool keeps this separate from its checks.

When the question grows beyond one excerpt, Eqvero provides the related public-disclosure research workflow. This MIT utility remains only a local record organizer, not source verification or an investment recommendation.

zh-Hant.title: 建立可覆核的披露證據帳本，保留原文與數字口徑
zh-Hant.description: 用三筆合成資料執行本機 CLI，查看兩筆需要人工補充的證據。
zh-Hant.body:
研究表格常留下數字，卻遺失定義這個數字的句子。這次練習從引文與位置開始，而不是先填估值模型。範例中的三筆披露內容全部是合成資料，不屬於真實公司公告。

1. 執行隨附範例

準備 Python 3.10 或更新版本，下載或 clone 儲存庫後，在儲存庫根目錄執行。工具沒有執行期第三方依賴。

python filing_evidence.py examples/sample.json --output examples/output
python -m unittest discover -p "test_*.py"

可先查看輸入 JSON。E01 的原句是「Revenue was USD 12 million for FY2025.」，數值以字串 12.00 保存；USD、million、FY2025 分別記錄為幣種、單位與期間。工具不換算數值，也不猜測其他幣種。

2. 把輸出當成交接資料，不是結論

3 evidence rows; 2 need field review. Sources not verified.

ledger.md 按研究問題整理證據；ledger.json 保留原始資料並附上欄位檢查。E02 有數值及單位，卻沒有期間，因此出現 missing:period；E03 有位置但缺少原文，產生 missing:quote。E01 沒有欄位缺漏，也不代表其內容真實。

3. 完成人工覆核

換成自己的資料後，開啟真實公告，確認措辭、頁碼與上下文，再補齊缺漏。範例的來源網址只指向練習資料，不應當成公司公告。reviewed 只記錄你完成的工作，與工具的欄位檢查互不替代。

需要跨公告追查問題時，可使用相關的 Eqvero 公開披露研究工作流。這個 MIT 工具仍然只是本機記錄整理器，不核驗事實，也不提供投資建議。

en.title: A complete evidence row is not a verified source
en.description: Separate required fields, number context and human review status before handing a research note to someone else.
en.body:
There are three different questions in an evidence handoff: is the record complete, did someone inspect the original, and is the interpretation justified? This program answers only the first through deterministic field checks. It stores a user's answer to the second and cannot answer the third.

What the checks actually mean

The required fields are id, question, title, source_url, location and quote. A nonempty value must also have a unit and period. Currency and disclosure date are preserved when provided, but their meaning is not inferred. A percentage, for example, need not have a currency.

{"id":"E02","value":"9.0","unit":"million","period":""}
→ missing:period

This abbreviated row also lacks several required fields. A checklist can therefore contain multiple items for the same row. Duplicate IDs are reported on every affected row, rather than silently replacing an earlier excerpt.

Preserve the source's scale

Use strings for reported values: "0", "12.00" or "(3.2)". The tool retains that representation without doing arithmetic. A numeric JSON value triggers a precision reminder because a parser may already have removed trailing zeros. Do not silently replace an unknown value with zero.

Use status without overstating it

unreviewed is the default; reviewed is a user-entered status. Neither state makes a network request. A valid-looking HTTP URL proves neither availability nor authority, and a quote field can contain incorrect words. Keep a reviewer’s reasoning in the input context or a separate note rather than treating a clean checklist as approval.

Before sharing, check the original disclosure date, page convention and numerical scope yourself. The utility does not fetch documents, reconcile financial statements or assess investments. Run the supplied test suite to reproduce the field rules, not to validate your research claims.

zh-Hant.title: 欄位完整，不代表來源已經核實
zh-Hant.description: 交接研究記錄前，分清欄位檢查、數值口徑與人工覆核狀態。
zh-Hant.body:
交接證據時有三個不同問題：記錄是否完整、是否有人查看原始文件、以及解讀是否合理。程式只透過確定性的欄位檢查回答第一個問題；它保存使用者對第二個問題的狀態，但無法回答第三個問題。

檢查項實際代表什麼

必要欄位是 id、question、title、source_url、location 與 quote。有非空數值時，還需要單位及期間。使用者提供的幣種和披露日期會原樣保存，但工具不推斷其含義；百分比便未必有幣種。

{"id":"E02","value":"9.0","unit":"million","period":""}
→ missing:period

這筆縮寫資料同時缺少其他必要欄位，因此同一列可能出現多個待辦。重複 ID 會標示在每一筆相關記錄上，不會默默覆蓋較早的引文。

保留原來的數值表達

用字串保存數字，例如 "0"、"12.00" 或 "(3.2)"。工具保留原表示法，不做計算。若輸入 JSON 數字而非字串，會提醒精度問題，因為解析時可能已經遺失末尾的零。未知值也不應自行填成零。

記錄狀態，不誇大狀態

預設狀態是 unreviewed；reviewed 由使用者填寫。兩者都不觸發網路請求。格式正常的 HTTP 網址不代表可用或權威，而引文欄也可能填錯。覆核理由應保留在上下文或另附筆記中，不要把沒有缺漏的清單當成審批結果。

分享前仍需親自檢查披露日期、頁碼規則與數值範圍。工具不抓文件、不核對財務報表，也不評估投資。測試套件驗證的是欄位規則，不是研究結論的正確性。
